The '''Kaon City Spaceport''' was the main [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on [[Kaon]], located in the [[Kaon City]]. In [[3639 BBY]] it became the epicenter of the [[Tion Hegemony rakghoul outbreak]] on Kaon. Doctor [[Sannus Lorrick]] hired a spacer named [[Melarra]] to make a delivery to Kaon, which secretly consisted of [[Rakghoul]]s. As soon as the shuttle touched down, rakghouls burst pouring out of its cargo hold and began spreading the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], leading to eventual quarantine of Kaon. Melarra herself was able to avoid being infected and hid inside the spaceport for days, until she was eventually discovered by an off-world strike team and provided them with the location of Lorrick's base on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kaon City Spaceport appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Kaon Under Siege" flashpoint.
